newsitem.title: USA: Renaissance opens hotels in India, Japan.
newsitem.headline: Renaissance opens hotels in India, Japan.

text.p: Renaissance Hotel Group NV said Friday it is opening the Ramada International Hotel Manohar in Hyderabad, India and has signed a franchise agreement for a Ramada hotel in Japan
Renaissance said the 134-room hotel in Hyderabad opened October 1 near the Begumpet International Airport and is the company's third franchise in India.
The Ramada International Hotel Tokyo Kinshi-Cho, with 383 rooms, should open in June 1997, Renaissance said. The company has five Renaissance hotels in Japan.

"We are very confident that there is a vast potential for the mid-priced Ramada International brand in Asia and we are actively pursuing the growth of that brand today," stated company Chief Executive Michael Williams.
Renaissance offers lodging under the Renaissance, New World and Ramada International names. It has 146 properties in 38 countries.
